facts.fact: 孩子房的 strap 落地、门全开——粉房间玩具卡车、黄房间流行海报。
facts.anchor: The strap that had secured the children’s doors was now lying in a heap on the ground

facts.fact: Dawes 已流尽血——走廊成一面亮黑镜子一直铺到厨房。
facts.anchor: the hallway was a shining black mirror all the way to the kitchen.

facts.fact: 副手 Andrews 折臂而立、怒惧交织——他也是这些人的朋友；眼神怪 Alex。
facts.anchor: a strange look of fury and fear on his face. Alex thought his name was… Andrews.

facts.fact: Brian 时间线：孩子睡下、April 上楼、他睡不着倒酒看 SportsCenter——然后没了。
facts.anchor: So I went and I poured a drink, I put on SportsCenter, then…

facts.fact: Dawes 不是他请进来的——记忆 fuzzy。
Alex 假设：凶手把门开着引诱 Dawes——他一踏进就出手。
facts.anchor: Maybe the killer opened the door, left it that way, lured him up. And the second he stepped in, he struck.

facts.fact: 露台门：他睡前总会检查——今晚不确定是否锁了。
facts.anchor: I was awake, so, I mean, I always check before I go to bed.

facts.fact: Alex 断言：他不是第一次进屋——带了 strap、知道布局、知道你睡前会喝一杯。
facts.anchor: He brought a strap to keep the kids’ doors locked. He knew the layout

facts.fact: Brian 问「你觉得是我们的错吗？」——Alex：「你告诉我。」
